label: PF Backlog 453
title: PF: per-item claim (single claimer) + assignment API + assignment package + worker role
body:
Child of the parallel-run-engine epic. Extend the EXISTING single claimer (job_manager.claim_next) from
per-PROJECT to per-ITEM so N items in one project can be claimed concurrently; expose the external-worker
assignment lifecycle and create the worktree at claim.

Scope: (1) job_manager claim keyed by item (atomic re-check, keep IS-PF-0034 single claimer); (2) assignment API
- POST /api/v1/engineering/assignments/claim (records backlog.set_execution worker_id/assignment_id/lease,
returns the assignment package: item, title, description, acceptance_criteria, pidl_context, execution_policy,
worktree, branch, base_ref) + POST .../{id}/heartbeat (renew_lease) + .../complete + .../fail + .../release;
(3) worktree+branch created at claim via core/vcs (fetch latest develop, base/rebase policy); (4) auth: new
`worker` role in api/auth.py; assignment endpoints require worker (merge/pause/capacity stay operator);
(5) capacity: max_parallel_assignments cap enforced at claim.

Out of scope: delivery/merge (C3), validation isolation (C2), WorkerGrid client (C5).

Descriptors: module:core/job_manager.py; module:core/vcs.py; module:api/auth.py; module:api/routers/engineering.py;
test:test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_assignments_api.py; route:POST /api/v1/engineering/assignments/claim.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; precheck --full green (39 gates); lease gate green; new test_assignments_api.py (6 tests). claim_next is now per-ITEM: two items in ONE project claimed in parallel by two workers (verified) - the per-project serialization is removed. Assignment API (claim/heartbeat/complete/fail/release) + worker role + max_parallel_assignments cap.

_note: per-item assignment delivered (parallel backlog execution unblocked)

dashboard_impact.reason: Operator surface is /wg status + the PF API (assignments view); the dashboard is a separate surface and stays out of this slice
